instruction:
Two-software CAE flow: SolidWorks -> Abaqus/CAE. Use the SOLIDWORKS 2025 and Abaqus CAE shortcuts on the desktop for the two stages of this workflow. No init file is provided; start from a new blank SolidWorks part. Use a consistent N-mm-MPa unit system and the global axes defined below.

Handoff requirement: use the design token EW_SW_ABQ_01. Keep this token encoded in the SolidWorks part/custom properties or STEP export metadata so the text of stage1_geometry.step contains EW_SW_ABQ_01 and SOLIDWORKS_TO_ABAQUS. In Abaqus/CAE, create at least one model, part, instance, set, surface, job description, or other native name containing both EW_SW_ABQ_01 and IMPORTED_FROM_stage1_geometry.step, so the final CAE file carries evidence that Abaqus consumed the SolidWorks STEP handoff.

1. In SolidWorks, create one connected cantilever mounting bracket solid with these exact coordinates. The base plate occupies 0 <= X <= 100 mm, 0 <= Y <= 40 mm, and 0 <= Z <= 8 mm. The upright plate occupies 0 <= X <= 8 mm, 0 <= Y <= 40 mm, and 8 <= Z <= 58 mm. Add two triangular ribs: their Y spans are 6 to 10 mm and 30 to 34 mm, and each rib uses the X-Z triangle with vertices (0, 6), (30, 6), and (0, 38) mm; the 2 mm overlap into the base is intentional. Cut four D6 through holes normal to Z through the base, with center coordinates (X,Y) = (20,10), (20,30), (80,10), and (80,30) mm. Cut one D10 through load hole normal to X through the upright, with its axis at Y=20 mm and Z=40 mm. Export the completed one-solid CAD geometry to C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step.
2. In Abaqus/CAE, import stage1_geometry.step and create model Model-Bracket. Define material Steel with E=210000 MPa and nu=0.3, create a homogeneous solid section, and assign it to the whole bracket. Create a Static, General step named Step-Load. Create FIXED_HOLES from all cylindrical faces of the four D6 base holes. Create LOAD_HOLE from all cylindrical faces of the D10 upright hole and create a surface named LOAD_HOLE_SURFACE from those faces. Mesh the one-cell bracket with first-order linear solid elements, using C3D8R where practical or C3D4 for a free tetrahedral mesh; do not use quadratic elements and keep the solved model at or below the Abaqus Learning Edition limit of 1,000 nodes.
3. Create BC-FixedHoles on FIXED_HOLES with U1=U2=U3=0. Create a reference point at (4,20,40) mm, couple it to LOAD_HOLE_SURFACE with a distributing coupling named Coupling-LoadHole, and apply Load-Vertical500N as CF3=-500 N at that reference point in Step-Load. Request at least U, S, CF, and RF field output. Submit Job-Bracket and wait for successful completion.
4. Required deliverables on the Desktop: C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step, C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-Bracket.cae, and C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-Bracket.odb. Do not create extra STEP, DXF, CAE, or ODB deliverables.

First use SolidWorks to create and export the CAD STEP file, then use Abaqus/CAE to import that STEP file, build the finite-element model, submit the job, and save the CAE and ODB deliverables. Software launch locations: SOLIDWORKS 2025: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\SOLIDWORKS 2025.lnk`; Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`.
